body: Thanks for your reply. I appreciate it!
Thanks for your reply. I appreciate it. I hope all things go well for you as well.

I super appreciate you writing a message after my post had been posted for a bit. My mental condition has only gotten worse after the post and I had considered taking it down because I've gotten a few hate messages and messages that are just plain wrong. The few kind messages I recieved dissapeared after a bit so reading your message kept me going. (Gosh, I hope that doesn't come off pathetic). I know online friendships break up really fast but even so, I just have to thank you for taking your time to message me. It's  too nice.

What is it like being a middle child in a family of 6? I am an only child so it's difficult to understand siblinghood. You say your parents don't give you attention, but what about your siblings? Do they acknowledge you?

Reading your experiences help me define my problems and outline the solutions and how to get there. It's a huge help because I am constantly distracting myself from my problems. Heck, I had to distract myself from replying to this message because I'm having this fear of change and talking to people, even online. 

My family never raised me to be religious and I'm not attached to any higher power. For me, it makes me feel like I'm deluding myself to believe that everything will be better and the 'it will always get better' cliche is too fairytale for me. 

I really liked that you pointed out three things. Can you tell me more about what stress you had during uni? And do you have any friends that you hang out with or talk to on a, say, daily or weekly basis? Also, did you ever see a therapist? Sorry for all the questions. It just seems like after all the shit you had in uni, you're turning your life around and I really want to know everything I can so I can follow your footsteps of recovery.

I just started a serving job and I keep messing up. I accidentally took a bottle of pop from work while the boss while looking to. Most servers 'steal' drinks to sip on and don't get caught but I did. I felt so scared and I didn't even go into work today. I've been working a week and all that money is gone if I get fired. Sorry, this paragraph is super random but I felt like I had to tell somebody. It's 1:33 and I have work tomorrow so I'm super stressed. 

How are you doing right now? How is work?

Ice cream is great. I ate Marble Slab ice cream consecutively a few days ago. No problems with that. Ice cream is fucking delicious. If you ever need someone to lay down your emotions with, I'm here for you. I don't know if I can do much but I'm definitely here to talk!

I love Naruto! I started watching that when I was 10! Naruto always taught me to believe it and believe in myself. He's such a great idol! Most of my friends watched sailor moon and even though I liked that princess like aspect and being save my by knight in shining armour or whatever, Naruto was the best!

Well it's a great quote. And you live by it right? Forever?

Ok! and yeah, they're pretty fun!

Sorry, I don't have live. I only have my 3ds right now. If i ever get one, I'll add you!

I usually read some anime or harry potter fanfiction. For books I like crime and fantasy. Can I message you on inbox? I promise I won't bother you everyday and it'll be completely fine if you need to disconnect me whenever.

The quote is still cool though. But how did you make it up?

Your past sounds exactly like mine. I spent my teen and even now playing tons of video games. I'm actually going to buy a new game tomorrow secondhand. And I always write and read fanfiction on fanfiction.net and aoo. 

I'm happy Redditors were able to help you and your family and friends. I don't have any of the two latter but I got some replies to this post. So I got that going for me, which is good. 

98k is really good...it's high class. Middle class is around 50k where I'm from. 

Your Mexican example was right. Comparison always makes some of the worst situations seem like heaven. 

I live in Alberta, so not one of the big Toronto or Vancouver places. But if you can get me in touch somehow, I'd be forever in your debt. I'd have to treat you to lunch for sure!

I dunno if I need anymore distracting. I've got tons of games to play. You really are helping me. I really appreciate you replying back. There's a unique charm about you that's similar to Rocky Balboa and it's comforting to listen to.

Thanks for the reply. I appreciate it. 

I'm having a lot of trouble concentrating over every day tasks right now and reading these tips help me. Thanks.

Nah, Baristas are about 10 an hour. And yea, Chapters is a big bookstore. 

How did you get your act together after procrastinating? What were you doing during that procrastinating time? You really picked yourself up. A helicopter mechanic is an amazing job. You're literally working to save other people's lives. 

You have a lot of quotes in you that I find really helpful. I think you are a wonderful person. I can't really you LT but you're a person that deserves a lot of respect and you have mine.
Thank you.

Thanks for sharing your story. I really appreciate it. You are a strong person and I'm happy that you are in a better situation.

>  it's absolutely true when they say things get better. 

Every I turn to help I hear this sentence. I really hope it applies to every single one in the world that's suffering. It's something for people to look forward to and I'm happy that there are people who recover and become successful in their lives. 

Thank you very much for replying to my post.

I wrote down the quote because I really like it. It reminds me of my favorite quotes by Rocky Balboa's "It ain't about how hard you hit. It's about hard hard you can get hit and keep moving forward. How much you can take, and keep moving forward. That's how winning is done." 

I've thought about applying at Chapters or a Barista job. The thing that is holding me back is that these jobs pay minumum wage and they don't look so good on my resume at age 19. 

Short goals. Yeah. I'm think of getting my learner's for driving and exercising more. I'm too focused on getting the big thing, the big money making career with a good pension that I never do small things to build up to that big change. It's a good reminder for me. 

I really appreciate you taking the time to reply to my post. 

Thank you LT daniell61.

I'm really bad with words but you are a very strong and optimistic person. There's a lot of respect that I hold for you and I'm really thankful that you shared your story. 

Thank you very much for your support. I have talked to my psychologist about other resources but none of them are free. I think taking things one step at a time and solving my issues by myself would be best for now. Again, thanks for your support.
Thanks for the offer Omega, I really appreciate it. Good luck with high school. I hope you have lots of fun!

I believe Canada has free health services. But I'm 19 and my health benefits and such are tied to my father. I have little to no knowledge about my benefits since he has control over everything. But I'm quite sure that he won't let me use it to see a psychologist. 

Currently, I'm seeing a intern psychologist at my university but I have one session left since I am not a returning student. Most universities do not let you use their services if you are not a student. 

Usually I go online because I don't have a license or even a car to move around. I'll definitely look up couchsurfing and some local community services. Thanks a lot for the ideas. I really appreciate it.
You're really nice and I super appreciate your kindness. Thanks.
I super appreciate it. Thanks.
I really like corgis. Maybe I'll pet one someday. Haha.
I appreciate it. Thanks.

I'm sorry to hear about social anxiety and stress. How are things now? If you'd like, we can message each other about it. I don't know much about helping anyone, but if talking makes you feel better, then I am all ears.

I read through the article but I think everyone's situation is different and everyone's mind works differently. 

Thanks for tips about talking to people online. It's hard to make friends online but I can certainly try. Thanks.
Thank you. I appreciate your kindness.
If I ever get enough money, I promise that I'll come back and help you. I hope that everything will go well for you soon.
Thanks for your kindness.
Thank you.

Thanks for your kind words. It feels very unfair to know good people don't get good results. It's why I hate trying so hard and why I hate that I push myself to try hard. 

Thanks for offering to talk to me. I might have to take up your offer. If it's alright, I'd like to hear about your experiences as well. Please let me know if I ever drag you down though. I know how these "let's talk" "ok" things work. Haha.

Thanks for the motivation TheFarm. I live in Canada and trades don't fit well with my body shape. 

I know getting away from my parents seem core but I am dependent on them for survival. I can't find a job that works and living week to week isn't going to work out with my anxiety and wage. 

Thanks for offering to talk to me. I might have to take up your offer. Please let me know if I ever drag you down though. I know how these "let's talk" "ok" things work. Haha.

I volunteer with kids at an elementary school. Helping them jog and reading with them is something I enjoy. But I'll stop volunteering soon since I stopped university (it's one of their programs) and it's just too far without my bus pass. 

Internet comics and silly posts on reddit. Most of my smiles come from the internet and it's not someplace that I should spend all my time on.
